prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and timeline. To give you a useful recommendation I need a few details. Quick questions:

- What’s your primary goal? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce revenue, SEO, paid ads, content, product growth, etc.)
- Monthly or campaign budget range (ballpark)?
- Company size / stage (startup pre‑product, growth stage, SMB, enterprise)?
- Target audience (B2B, B2C, enterprise, SMB, geographic markets)?
- Any channels that must be prioritized? (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, SEO, email, programmatic, creative/video)
- Deadline or expected timeline for results?

What I can do next
- If you answer the questions above, I’ll create a curated shortlist (3–5 agencies) in San Francisco matched to your needs, with:
  - Why each is a fit (strengths, specialties)
  - Typical pricing/engagement model and what to expect from a pilot
  - Suggested questions to ask them and red flags to watch for
  - Example KPIs and a simple scope for a 60–90 day test engagement

If you want a quick, generic starting point now: for large-brand creative and integrated campaigns consider R/GA, AKQA or Goodby Silverstein; for performance-driven paid and growth marketing look at Ladder and 3Q Digital; for SEO and content-focused work consider boutique SEO firms (I can find the best options once you give more detail). Note: I can vet recent case studies and client references for any agency I recommend.

Tell me the details above and I’ll build your tailored shortlist.
